chapters.title: Worlds I Still Remember
chapters.description: Games that shaped my taste for atmosphere, exploration, and the feeling of inhabiting a place.

chapters.title: Stories That Stayed
chapters.description: Character-driven games that changed my standards for tone, pacing, and emotional payoff.

chapters.title: Loops I Kept Returning To
chapters.description: Games whose repeatable actions, feedback, and short-term goals made me keep coming back.

chapters.title: Systems I Learned From
chapters.description: Strategy, progression, economy, and combat systems that I keep revisiting as design references.

chapters.title: Nostalgia & Milestones
chapters.description: Games tied to specific moments in my gaming life, even when my designer brain sees them differently now.

chapters.title: Lessons From Friction
chapters.description: Games that did not fully work for me, but still left useful questions about player trust, feel, scope, and expectation.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.reflection: A benchmark for world texture, quiet pacing, and how small travel moments can make a place feel lived in.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.reflection: A strong memory of mystery, danger, and discovery pulling the player forward without over-explaining the path.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.reflection: A reminder that side content can feel meaningful when local stakes, character writing, and world context support it.

games.title: Persona 5 Royal
games.reflection: A personal standard for how style, routine, UI identity, and character arcs can reinforce each other.

games.title: Persona 3 Reload
games.reflection: A useful reference for atmosphere, limited time pressure, and the emotional weight of repeated daily decisions.

games.title: L.A. Noire
games.reflection: A memorable case of performance capture, detective fantasy, and the tension between authored drama and player interpretation.

games.title: Plants vs. Zombies GOTY Edition
games.reflection: A clean reminder that casual strategy works when readability, escalation, and reward timing stay simple but expressive.

games.title: Peggle Deluxe
games.reflection: A small lesson in anticipation, clear feedback, and how a single input can still create drama.

games.title: Dead Cells
games.reflection: A strong loop reference for fast restarts, readable combat, and progression that softens failure without removing tension.

games.title: Hades II
games.reflection: A reference for how character writing and mechanical repetition can make repeated runs feel less like repetition.

games.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
games.reflection: A systems reference for compounding decisions, readable tradeoffs, and the danger of one-more-turn pacing.

games.title: Total War: Three Kingdoms
games.reflection: A useful mix of campaign-layer relationships, battlefield spectacle, and systemic tension between loyalty and ambition.

games.title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance
games.reflection: A reference for grounded role-play, friction as identity, and progression that asks the player to inhabit weakness first.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.reflection: One of the games that made wandering feel like a valid goal, even before I had language for open-world structure.

games.title: Assassin's Creed II
games.reflection: A milestone memory for movement fantasy, historical spaces, and how a strong protagonist can anchor a long journey.

games.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War
games.reflection: A compact memory of how illustration, puzzle pacing, and historical tone can carry emotion without mechanical complexity.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.reflection: A useful case study in ambition, expectation, immersion breaks, and how post-launch iteration can reshape perception.

games.title: eFootball 2022
games.reflection: A sharp reminder that feel, animation clarity, and trust are fragile when a familiar loop changes too abruptly.

games.title: Battlefield 2042
games.reflection: A useful friction case for scale, class identity, readability, and how expectation shapes multiplayer reception.
